scope: Four weeks of default-branch commits plus enumeration of all open PRs and issues, including older ones. Selected diffs, discussions and source compared statically to Redcode.
limitations: Enumeration is not deep review of every item or commit.
REST pagination is not transactional. PR states in selected-prs.json were retrieved after the open-item enumeration and may differ.
Some initial commit pages used a branch name; inventories retain the observed head and deduplicate SHAs. This is an observed API inventory, not an independently cloned reachability proof.
Original pages.json covered only the first batch. This manifest covers all saved raw/source/detail files; exact request time or URL is absent for some legacy page files.
Local filesystem mtime describes persistence time, not GitHub state time.
No providers, upstream scripts, exploits, browser flows, paid calls or runtime tests executed in this research.
No complete feature parity, readiness or deployment claim.
repository_artifacts_note: Repository artifact hashes record the study delivery before implementation. Living adoption documentation can change afterward; raw source and inventory hashes remain the study evidence.
